annotations.summary: Engine ovh stopped emitting its heartbeat gauge
annotations.description: The engine's heartbeat loop records the ircfiber.registration.timeout_networks gauge on every cycle (~10s, engine/source/ircfiber/engine/bootstrap.d), tagged serverId. Fewer than one data point in 3 minutes means that loop is not running, which is exactly the condition the admin dashboard reports as Healthy Engines 0/1 — ServerRegistry marks a server unhealthy once lastHeartbeat is older than 60s, and network assignments then stop being serviced. Counting the gauge rather than reading Redis works because the metric already ships today (IRCFIBER_OTEL_ENABLED=1 in host_vars/ircfiber-prod-1.yml). Check: docker exec ircfiber-redis redis-cli hget irc:server:ovh lastHeartbeat; docker logs --tail 100 ircfiber-engine-ovh; the admin dashboard Engines card.
